Description
Discover the elegance and investment potential of the 1/2 oz PAMP Suisse Rosa Gold Bar. Manufactured by MKS PAMP, the world’s leading independent refiner of precious metals, this gold bar blends timeless beauty with superior quality.
The stunning rose design imprinted on the front of the bar adds a unique aesthetic appeal, making it a popular choice among investors and collectors alike.
Product Highlights:
Metal: 999.9 Fine Gold
Weight: 0.5 Ounce (15.55g)
Design: Rose in full bloom with two budding stems
Packaging: Individually registered and secured in protective CertiPAMP™ packaging
Assurance: Includes an integrated official Assay Certificate for guaranteed purity and weight
Accreditation: Certified by the Swiss Federal Bureau
Why Choose the PAMP Suisse Rosa Gold Bar?
Exceptional Craftsmanship: The rose design symbolizes beauty and rarity, making this gold bar not just an investment, but a piece of art.
Trusted Excellence: Produced by PAMP (Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux), synonymous with quality and authenticity since its founding in 1977.
Investment-Grade: Composed of 0.5 oz of .9999 fine gold, these bars are eligible for Precious Metals IRAs, offering a reliable and easily tradable form of investment.
Secure Packaging: Each bar is individually controlled, registered, and sealed in CertiPAMP™ packaging with a certificate to verify authenticity and weight.
Global Recognition: PAMP gold bars are recognized as Good Delivery by major international markets, including the Swiss National Bank and London Bullion Market Association.
Iconic Design: The obverse displays the weight and purity, individual serial number, and registered “Essayeur Fondeur” (Assayer-Refiner) stamp, while the reverse features the beautiful rose design.
Enhance your investment portfolio with this exquisite 1/2 oz PAMP Suisse Rosa gold bar. Its highly detailed design and impeccable quality make it a valuable addition to any collection. Order now from Bullion Trading LLC and secure your piece of this world-renowned gold bar today! Note: The design of the packaging may vary.
